name: Jien
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 95); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: Unfit to rule this wicked world
poems.author: Jien
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 95
poems.text:
Unfit to rule this wicked world
With all its pomp and pride,
I’d rather in my plain black robe
A humble priest abide,
Far up the mountain side.

poems.title: 95. おほけなく うき世の民に おほふかな (Okenaku ukiyo no tami ni oou kana)
poems.author: Jien
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 千載集
poems.text:
おほけなく うき世の民に おほふかな
我が立つ杣に 墨染の袖
